title: fix(plugin-list): a filter row with no value is not a filter, a date sort reads Oldest → Newest, one sort row per field, and an empty list says how to start
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuYMKU2Un7YLKcuYSwjb25e1)_

Part of #27520 (rows 7 and 17 built; row 21 measured and not built because it no longer reproduces; the card's other open rows stay on it)

Clause-②: yes (widening: `@object-ui/i18n` gains `list.clearSearch`, `sortBuilder.oldestFirst` and `sortBuilder.newestFirst` in all ten locales, and `SortBuilder`'s `fields` entries take an optional `type`; no accept set moves)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：列表工具栏四处小改。筛选面板里还没填值的行不再算进筛选徽标、不再让列表显示「无匹配记录」、也不再被存进用户的列表状态；日期/日期时间字段排序显示「最早 → 最新」而不是「A → Z」；同一字段不能在排序里加两次；搜索导致的「无匹配记录」空状态多一个「清除搜索」按钮；空列表在用户有新建权限时给出「新建」按钮，不再要求视图写 `addRecord.enabled`。
- **为什么改**：18.3.0 RC 走查（#27520 第 7、17 行）在 Tasks 列表上看到：空筛选行算进徽标并在刷新后回来；日期排序写着 A → Z；同字段可重复排序；搜索跨导航保留，回来只看到「无匹配记录」却没有出口；新对象的空列表没有新建按钮。
- **风险与回滚**：只动前端列表组件和三个新翻译键，不改服务端、不改 spec。筛选只是少存未完成的行，面板里照样显示，用户可以继续填；空状态的新建仍受新建权限（`listNew`）约束，作者显式写 `addRecord.enabled: false` 仍然隐藏。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`（`appliedFilterGroup`、`emptyStateOffersCreate`、`onClearSearch`）；`ui/packages/components/src/custom/sort-builder.tsx`（`takenElsewhere`、`directionLabels`）；`ListView.toolbarRows-27520.test.tsx`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.toolbarRows-27520.test.tsx packages/components/src/__tests__/sort-builder-date-direction-duplicates-27520.test.tsx` → 2 个文件 19 个用例全绿。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地（新增 i18n 键属 Clause-② widening，席位先做 TIER_DEFAULT 复核）。

## What changes

Measured on `main` `af6ca001` before any code, by reading the code and then pinning each item red through the real `ListView` / `SortBuilder`:

| Item | On `main` | This PR |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Row 7: filter row with no value | counted on the badge (`shownFilterCount` counted every row), made the list "No matching records", and was handed whole to `onFilterChange`, which the console stores as the user's list state (`listPrefs.patchView`) | not counted, not a user query, not handed to the host; the panel still shows it so it can be finished |
| Row 7: date sort direction | `SortBuilder` had no field type, so every row read "A → Z" | a `date` / `datetime` row reads "Oldest → Newest" / "Newest → Oldest"; `ListView` hands each sort field's type |
| Row 7: duplicate sort field | every row offered every field; "Add sort" seeded the first field even when a row held it | a field another row holds is unavailable in this row; "Add sort" seeds the first free field and is disabled once none is left |
| Row 7: "No matching records" after a search | no way out in the empty state | "Clear search", which clears the search and tells the host (`onSearchChange('')`) |
| Row 17: empty list, no New | the empty-state Create was drawn only when the view declared `addRecord.enabled: true`, which few views do, although the console hands `onAddRecord` exactly when its header New is offered | drawn whenever the host hands a create path and `mayCreate` allows it; an explicit `addRecord: { enabled: false }` or `userActions.addRecordForm: false` still withholds it; a view that declares the inline block keeps it as before |
| Row 21: "In a queue" tooltip | **does not reproduce**: the toggle carries `title={t('list.sittingInQueueHint')}` in all ten packs and is drawn only on an object the server serves with its injected `queue` column (`objectHasOwnershipQueue`), both since #27264 (`2302b92b`, an ancestor of the walkthrough's `c4c515ad`) | not built (reported) |

Not built here, reported: Studio's list-view sort (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/ObjectListViewInspector.tsx`, held by #28148) hands `SortBuilder` fields without `type`, so its date label stays "A → Z" until that file passes `type: f.type`. The duplicate refusal lives in `SortBuilder` itself, so Studio's sort gets it with no edit there.

The search box's own clear (×) button is still unnamed; it is frozen in `iconOnlyButtonCensus-12143`'s backlog and is left to that card.

## Tests

- New: `ui/packages/components/src/__tests__/sort-builder-date-direction-duplicates-27520.test.tsx` (8), `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.toolbarRows-27520.test.tsx` (11). Each negative sits beside a control on the same rig.
- Red first on unfixed source (tracked changes stashed, new tests kept): 11 failed / 8 passed, each on its target assertion (no option disabled, badge still counts the unfinished row, `onFilterChange` receives the unfinished row, no "Clear search", no `empty-state-add-record`).
- Adapted, not deleted: `ListView.sortRemovableOnly-11943.test.tsx`, two controls that read the old duplicate behaviour ("Add sort" seeded the field the first row held; a field held by the other row was read from the first row's dropdown).
- Suite: `vitest run packages/plugin-list/ packages/components/ packages/plugin-view/ packages/i18n/` under the verify lock: 816 files, 6 reds in 4 files, all from this change's first cut (the two adapted controls; two `emptyStateLink-12270` and one `ObjectGallery.emptyState-12217` case that read a declared `addRecord.enabled` with no host handler, answered by keeping that leg; one `iconOnlyButtonCensus-12143` count from an aria-label I then took back out). Those 7 files rerun green: 50/50.
- Ablations through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each restored to the HEAD blob (`git diff HEAD` empty after every leg): taken-elsewhere returns false → 1 red; date label test → false → 2 red; "Add sort" ignores held fields → 2 red; emit the whole group → 1 red; badge from the whole group → 3 red; sort fields untyped → 1 red; host create leg off → 1 red; clear search off → 1 red; user query counts unfinished rows → 1 red.

## Acceptance notes

- `@object-ui/plugin-view` `ObjectView.tsx` was added to the claim's surface (amendment 6543827414) for one line, and is left unchanged: its `renderListView` branch is entered only when a host passes that prop, and Studio's design surface folds "+ New" into the list through it with `showCreate: false`, so withholding `onAddRecord` there would break Studio's New.
- No live browser run; every case mounts the real `ListView` with the real `FilterBuilder` / `SortBuilder` and Radix `Select`.

## Verification

All local readings at head `81af3395` (the merge of `origin/main` `380a1078` is in it).

All 34 exited 0, among them `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs`, `pnpm check:nul-bytes`, `pnpm check:type-check-debt` and `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (169 files passed, 2 skipped; 4901 tests). `--ran` on the recorded list: "34 derived, 34 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN … a DERIVED zero — all 34 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3".
